The Hermes plugin's sync_turn() method sends conversation observations
to the agentmemory /observe endpoint using keys 'input' and 'output',
but the server's mem::observe handler extracts data using 'tool_input'
and 'tool_output' (see src/functions/observe.ts).

This key mismatch means raw.toolInput and raw.toolOutput are always
undefined. When auto-compress is enabled, the LLM receives a nearly
empty compression promp

fix(hooks): use printf -v for bash 3.2 compat (declare -g is 4.2+)

macOS ships /bin/bash 3.2 and the script uses #!/bin/bash with
set -euo pipefail, so declare -g would abort the SessionStart hook
with "invalid option" on every Mac. printf -v writes via assignment
semantics (global from inside a function on 3.2+) — same scope
outcome, broader compatibility.

fix(memory): observer-based cache coherence for UnifiedStore writes

UnifiedStore now fires upsert/delete events after every committed
semantic-memory mutation; MemoryManager subscribes to keep its
in-process _memories cache in lock-step with SQLite. This eliminates
the class of bugs where writes that bypass MemoryManager (lifecycle
synthesis, API routes, plugin backends) left the cache stale or with
ghost entries.

User-reported bug fixed: mm.delete_memory previously gated the DB
delete on cach
